app.name: DS Remote Desktop
app.short_description: Stream PC desktop to Nintendo DS via Wii proxy
app.long_description:
DS Remote Desktop is a tri-node streaming stack that bridges a PC, Wii, and Nintendo DS over the NiFi ad-hoc 802.11b protocol.
Features: • PC desktop capture downscaled to DS resolution (256×192) • Paletted 8-bit video compression (RLE keyframes + delta updates) • Optional ADPCM audio streaming • Optional HMAC-SHA256 telemetry authentication • DS stylus + button input relay to PC • Automatic channel latency calibration (1, 6, 11 MHz) • 4ms ACK spoofing to maintain NiFi timing integrity • Mode A (Wi-Fi) or Mode B (USB Ethernet backhaul)
Setup: 1. Prepare SD card with proxy.cfg in sd:/apps/dsremote/ 2. Place haxxstation.nds (DS Download Station Vol 1) on SD root 3. Run wii-ds-rom-sender or equivalent to push DS client to RAM 4. Launch PC host targeting Wii IP
Requires: Homebrew Channel, USB Ethernet adapter (recommended)
app.changelog: v1.0.0 (2026-03-10): • Initial hardware-ready release • Real WD backend for Wii radio • Channel latency calibration with ping/pong diagnostics • Full tri-node (DS/Wii/PC) implementation • HMAC authentication and audio streaming support
